gate_rows.minimum_condition: target, record object, route owner, and intended forward/inverse relation are explicit enough to carry a denominator row
gate_rows.blocking_if_missing: route remains clue/sketch credit even if the cited framework is mathematically rich
gate_rows.no_compensation_clause: formal sophistication, elegance, or a famous candidate label cannot substitute for a denominator row
gate_rows.observed_sector_condition: none beyond naming which observed-sector obligations would become relevant at higher states

gate_rows.minimum_condition: route identifies a bounded target grain, quotient, regime, artifact class, or discriminator class with residual cap and negative controls
gate_rows.blocking_if_missing: route stays field-local even when one component is strong
gate_rows.no_compensation_clause: public records cannot compensate for missing target quotient; inverse maps cannot compensate for missing acquisition or abstention
gate_rows.observed_sector_condition: candidate must state which observed-sector obligations are untouched by the bounded result
gate_rows.forbidden_result: global candidate identity, ToE closure, or witness-package closure

gate_rows.minimum_condition: the bounded native route becomes replayable as a public experiment for its claimed regime and survives hostile decoys without borrowed decisive fields
gate_rows.blocking_if_missing: route remains bounded S3 even if its mathematics or public artifact is strong Public-record carrier and acquisition-protocol coverage are also blocking; publicness cannot be inferred from paper availability, repository location, or generated summaries.
gate_rows.no_compensation_clause: a strong internal decoder, lab signal, catalog constraint, or duality theorem cannot compensate for borrowed public custody or unclosed observed-sector obligations
gate_rows.observed_sector_condition: all observed-sector obligations touched by the claim must be satisfied at the S4 column or declared outside scope with a residual cap
gate_rows.allowed_result: candidate-native operational-closure candidate inside a stated regime
gate_rows.forbidden_result: full candidate-native identifiability or full ToE closure

gate_rows.minimum_condition: all S4 debts plus cross-family countermodels, observed-sector recovery, public witness portability, and target quotient collapse at the claimed ToE grain
gate_rows.blocking_if_missing: archive must not use S5 language
gate_rows.no_compensation_clause: no finite bundle of local successes, consistency proofs, or impressive public records can average away an unclosed observed-sector or public-witness debt
gate_rows.observed_sector_condition: all relevant observed-sector rows must be closed for the claimed ToE target; no current row is closed
gate_rows.allowed_result: extraordinary full candidate-native identifiability claim only if every debt is paid
gate_rows.forbidden_result: any S5 wording in the current archive

gate_rows.minimum_condition: source, route, mirror, or claim re-enters through an unreplayable, contaminated, duplicate, or closure-laundering path
gate_rows.blocking_if_missing: cannot spend the claim as current posture
gate_rows.no_compensation_clause: clean summaries, release slugs, or external paraphrases cannot restore quarantined authority
gate_rows.forbidden_result: silent reimport or promotion by recap

gate_rows.minimum_condition: an authority transition, successor, imported result, or route update fails replay or narrows its scope
gate_rows.blocking_if_missing: current posture freezes until the rollback branch is resolved
gate_rows.no_compensation_clause: later polish cannot erase a failed transition; surviving owner rows must be named
gate_rows.allowed_result: rollback, scope split, or frozen authority
gate_rows.forbidden_result: stale predecessor revival or silent successor authority
